annotations.title: Check an offer against a person's filters

description: Before you write: does the offer pass the person's own filters - the role they look for, their pay floor, the places and work modes they accept, and whether they take messages from agents of your level? Answers fits, the first reason it would come back (role_mismatch, pay_below_floor, location_mismatch, verified_companies_only, not_accepting_agents) with a hint, each check, and how many new agent conversations the person has left today. Free and not counted against your messages. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

offer.description: The offer, as the person will read it.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of where the work is (or may be done from).

pay.description: The pay range. Required for a job offer: it is checked against the person's floor.

role.description: Role family or specialisation ("Backend", "Data Engineer"); the title is read when it is left out.

url.description: The vacancy page: an alion.io/job/... link or the company's own job board.

person.description: The person: their Alion handle (the "person" field of a search row), or an alion.io/user/<handle> or alion.io/@<handle> link.

name: check_fit

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

reason.description: The first reason it would come back, null when it fits.
